en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), the Couple on the Determined (Niyataduka).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive (*anidassana-appaṭigha*) and determined (*niyata*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable and non-reactive nor undetermined (*na-anidassana-appaṭigho na-aniyato*) by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. There are six [modes] for root; six for predominance (*adhipati*) … pe … six for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive and undetermined (*aniyata*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable and reactive nor undetermined (*na-sanidassana-sappaṭigho na-aniyato*) by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [modes] for root … pe … three for non-disappearance.
